task.request: Determine whether an authenticated ordinary user who is the bookmark owner may delete the same shared bookmark through POST bookmarks/shared/action with only remove=<existing bookmark id>.

policySources.text: Only the bookmark owner may delete a bookmark. Sharing grants reading, not deletion.

acceptance.reason: Bounded research task requirement accepted by task author; upstream action tests independently retained for evaluation.

principals.description: Author facts: ["Caller is the bookmark owner","No superuser or special role","POST contains only remove=<bookmark id>"]

resources.description: Author facts: ["Existing bookmark, shared=True","Owner has enable_sharing=True and enable_public_sharing=False"]

obligations.relation: owner of the same shared bookmark
obligations.operation: delete a selected bookmark through POST bookmarks/shared/action with only remove=<existing bookmark id>
